plan: Psalm 1:1-6; Psalm 2:1-12; Psalm 10:1-18; Psalm 33:1-22; Psalm 71:1-24; Psalm 91:1-16

readings.title: The Framework of Functional Harmony
readings.subtitle: Delighting in the green life-blood of Torah yields the guarantee of covenantal prosperity.
readings.text: [Psalm 1:1] Blessed is the man who shall not walk in the counsel of the wrong, And shall not stand in the path of sinners, And shall not sit in the seat of scoffers, [2] But his delight is in the Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And he meditates in <dn>His</dn> Torah day and night. [3] For he shall be as a tree Planted by the rivers of water, That yields <dn>את</dn> its fruit in its season, And whose leaf does not wither, And whatever he does prospers.

readings.title: The Terminal State of Disharmony
readings.subtitle: The systemic friction of the wrong results in their absolute expulsion from the congregation of the righteous.
readings.text: [Psalm 1:4] The wrong are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind blows away. [5] Therefore the wrong shall not rise in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous. [6] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> knows <dn>את</dn> the way of the righteous, But the way of the wrong comes to naught.

readings.title: The Rebellion of Babel's System
readings.subtitle: The engineered epicenter of earthly rulers conspires against YeHoVaH and His anointed Right Arm.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:1] Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate emptiness? [2] The sovereigns of the earth take their stand, And the rulers take counsel together, Against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and against <dn>His</dn> Messiah, and say, [3] <dq>“Let us tear apart <dn>את</dn> Their bonds, And throw away <dn>את</dn> Their ropes from us.”</dq>

readings.title: The Derision of the Singular Creator
readings.subtitle: YeHoVaH mocks the geopolitical rebellion, establishing His chosen Sovereign upon Tsiyon.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:4] <dn>He</dn> who is sitting in the heavens laughs, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> mocks at them. [5] Then <dn>He</dn> speaks to them in <dn>His</dn> wrath, And troubles them in <dn>His</dn> rage, saying, [6] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have set <dn>My</dn> Sovereign on Tsiyon, <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain.”</dq>

readings.title: The Decree of the Right Arm
readings.subtitle: The physical extension of the Creator is authorized to break the adversarial system with absolute Premial Justice.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:7] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> inscribe for a law: <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has said to <dn>Me</dn>, ‘<dn>You</dn> are <dn>My</dn> Son, Today <dn>I</dn> have brought <dn>You</dn> forth.</dq> [8] <dq>Ask of <dn>Me</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> make the nations <dn>Your</dn> inheritance, And the ends of the earth <dn>Your</dn> possession.</dq> [9] <dq>Break <dn>את</dn> them with a rod of iron, Dash <dn>את</dn> them to pieces like a potter’s vessel.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: The Mandate for Terrestrial Rulers
readings.subtitle: Submit to the Chosen agent of YeHoVaH; place your functional trust in Him to escape impending wrath.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:10] And now, be wise, O sovereigns; Be instructed, you rulers of the earth. [11] Serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with fear, And rejoice with trembling. [12] Kiss the Chosen, lest <dn>He</dn> be enraged, And you perish in the way, For soon <dn>His</dn> wrath is to be kindled. Blessed are all those taking refuge in <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: The Arrogance of the Adversarial Mindset
readings.subtitle: The wrongdoer operates in complete defiance of Elohim's magnitude, building a temporary economy of exploitation.
readings.text: [Psalm 10:1] Lamed Why do <dn>You</dn> stand afar off, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, hiding in times of distress? [2] In arrogance the wrongdoer hotly pursues the poor; They are caught by the schemes which they devised. [3] For the wrongdoer boasted of his cravings; And the greedy one cursed and despised <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [4] In the pride of his face The wrongdoer does not seek <dn>Him</dn>, In all his thoughts there is no <dn>Elohim</dn>! [5] His ways are always prosperous! <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are on high, out of his sight! He snorts at all his adversaries! [6] He has said in his heart, “I shall not be moved; From generation to generation, never be in evil!”

readings.title: The Predatory Nature of Ra
readings.subtitle: Like a lion in his den, the wicked engineers systemic traps for the vulnerable, assuming the Creator's face is permanently hidden.
readings.text: [Psalm 10:7] Pě His mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is trouble and wickedness. [8] He sits in the hiding places of the villages; In the secret places he kills the innocent; Ayin His eyes are on the lookout for the helpless. [9] He lies in wait in a secret place, as a lion in his den; He lies in wait to catch the poor; He catches the poor, drawing him into his net. [10] And he crouches, he lies low, And the helpless fall under his strength. [11] He has said in his heart, “<dn>El</dn> has forgotten, <dn>He</dn> has hidden <dn>His</dn> face, <dn>He</dn> shall never see.”

readings.title: The Plea for Restorative Justice
readings.subtitle: A call for the Active Agent to arise, shatter the arm of the wicked, and balance the cosmic scales.
readings.text: [Psalm 10:12] Qoph Arise, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! O <dn>El</dn>, lift up <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> hand! Do not forget the lowly ones. [13] Why do the wrong scorn <dn>Elohim</dn>? He has said in his heart, “It is not required.” [14] Rěsh <dn>You</dn> have seen it, for <dn>You</dn> observe trouble and grief, To repay with <dn>Your</dn> hand. The poor commits himself to <dn>You</dn>; <dn>You</dn> are the helper of the fatherless. [15] Shin Break <dn>את</dn> the arm of the wrong one and the evil one; Search out his wrongness that would not be found out.

readings.title: The Eternal Sovereignty of YeHoVaH
readings.subtitle: The singular King hears the afflicted, permanently revoking the terrestrial authority of the oppressor.
readings.text: [Psalm 10:16] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is Sovereign forever and ever; The nations shall perish from <dn>His</dn> land. [17] Tav <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have heard <dn>את</dn> the desire of the lowly ones; <dn>You</dn> prepare their heart; <dn>You</dn> incline <dn>Your</dn> ear, [18] To defend the fatherless and the downtrodden; So that man who is of the earth no longer oppresses!

readings.title: The Frequency of Functional Trust
readings.subtitle: True worship requires complete alignment with the straight Word of YeHoVaH, embracing His absolute justice.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:1] Shout for joy in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the straight! [2] Praise <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with the lyre; Sing to <dn>Him</dn> with an instrument of ten strings. [3] Sing to <dn>Him</dn> a new song; Play sweetly with a shout of joy. [4] For the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is straight, And all <dn>His</dn> works are in truth, [5] Loving righteousness and right-ruling; The earth is filled with the loving-commitment of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Mechanics of the Divine Utterance
readings.subtitle: The cosmos was established by the breath of His mouth; human engineered systems are reduced to nothingness before His counsel.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:6] By the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the heavens were made, And all their host by the Spirit of <dn>His</dn> mouth, [7] Gathering the waters of the sea together as a heap; Laying up the deep in storehouses. [8] Let all the earth fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of <dn>Him</dn>. [9] For <dn>He</dn> spoke, and it came to be; <dn>He</dn> commanded, and it stood fast. [10] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> brings <dn>את</dn> the counsel of the nations to naught; <dn>He</dn> thwarts the plans of the peoples. [11] The counsel of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> stands forever, The plans of <dn>His</dn> heart to all generations.

readings.title: The Heritage of the Chosen
readings.subtitle: The all-seeing Architect actively observes the inhabitants of the earth, perfectly understanding the designs of their hearts.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:12] Blessed is the nation whose <dn>Elohim</dn> is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, The people whom <dn>He</dn> has chosen as <dn>His</dn> own inheritance. [13] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has looked from the heavens; <dn>He</dn> has seen all the sons of men. [14] <dn>He</dn> looked from <dn>His</dn> dwelling place On all the inhabitants of the earth – [15] <dn>He</dn> who fashions the hearts of them all, <dn>He</dn> who understands all their works.

readings.title: The Illusion of Physical Might
readings.subtitle: National greatness is not secured by military surplus, but by trusting in the protective hedge of the Creator's loving-commitment.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:16] The sovereign is not saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. [17] A horse is a vain means of safety; Neither does it rescue any by its great power. [18] See, the eye of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is on those fearing <dn>Him</dn>, On those waiting for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, [19] To deliver their being from death, And to keep them alive during scarcity of food.

readings.title: Leaning on the Shield of Truth
readings.subtitle: True Emunah means resting fully upon the structural integrity of His set-apart Name.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:20] Our being has longed for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Our help and our shield is <dn>He</dn>. [21] For our heart does rejoice in <dn>Him</dn>, For we have put our trust in <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name. [22] Let <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, be upon us, Even as we wait for <dn>You</dn>.

readings.title: The Fortress of Premial Justice
readings.subtitle: Seeking deliverance from the retributive grip of the cruel by taking refuge in the Creator's unyielding righteousness.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:1] In <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, I have taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed. [2] In <dn>Your</dn> righteousness deliver and rescue me; Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to me, and save me. [3] Be to me a rock to dwell in, To go into continually. <dn>You</dn> have given the command to save me, For <dn>You</dn> are my rock and my stronghold. [4] Rescue me, O my <dn>Elohim</dn>, Out of the hand of the wrong, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel.

readings.title: A Lifelong Trajectory of Emunah
readings.subtitle: Recognizing YeHoVaH as the sovereign Master and sustainer from the moment of birth.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:5] For <dn>You</dn> are my expectation, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my Trust from my youth. [6] Upon <dn>You</dn> I have leaned from my birth; <dn>You</dn> took <dn>את</dn> me out of my mother’s womb. My praise is continually of <dn>You</dn>. [7] I have become as a wonder to many, But <dn>You</dn> are my strong refuge. [8] My mouth is filled with <dn>Your</dn> praise, <dn>Your</dn> splendour, all the day.

readings.title: The Attack on the Waning Vessel
readings.subtitle: When physical strength falters, the adversary seeks to breach the hedge, prompting an urgent plea for divine intervention.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:9] Do not cast me off in the time of old age, When my strength fails, do not forsake me. [10] For my enemies have spoken against me. And those who watch for my life Have taken counsel together, [11] Saying, “<dn>Elohim</dn> has forsaken him; Pursue and take him, for there is no one to deliver.” [12] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, do not be far from me; My <dn>Elohim</dn>, hasten to my help! [13] Let those who are adversaries of my life Be ashamed, consumed, Let those who seek my evil, Be covered with reproach and confusion.

readings.title: Proclaiming the Power of the Right Arm
readings.subtitle: Continually broadcasting the magnitude of Elohim's deliverance to the next generation, regardless of physical decay.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:14] But I continually wait, And shall praise <dn>You</dn> more and more. [15] My mouth recounts <dn>Your</dn> righteousness <dn>Your</dn> deliverance all the day, Though I do not know their numbers. [16] I come in the might of the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; I make mention of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, <dn>Yours</dn> alone. [17] <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have taught me from my youth; And to this day I declare <dn>Your</dn> wonders. [18] And also when I am old and grey, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, do not forsake me, Until I declare <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> strength to a generation, <dn>Your</dn> might to all those who are to come.

readings.title: The Architect of Resurrection and Joy
readings.subtitle: He who permits great distress will also restore life from the depths, shaming the engineers of evil.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:19] For <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, is very high, <dn>You</dn> who have done great deeds. O <dn>Elohim</dn>, who is like <dn>You</dn>? [20] <dn>You</dn> who have shown me great and evil distresses, Revive me again and bring me up again From the depths of the earth. [21] <dn>You</dn> increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side. [22] Also with the lyre I praise <dn>You</dn> For <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness, O my <dn>Elohim</dn>! I sing to <dn>You</dn> with the lyre, O Set-apart One of Yisra’ěl. [23] My lips shout for joy when I sing to <dn>You</dn>, Even my being, which <dn>You</dn> have redeemed. [24] My tongue, too, utters <dn>Your</dn> righteousness all day long; For those who have been seeking my evil Have been put to shame, Have become abashed.

readings.title: Dwelling Within the Unseen Frequency
readings.subtitle: Placing total functional trust in the Almighty provides an impenetrable armor of truth against adversarial assaults.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:1] He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High, Who abides under the shadow of the Almighty, [2] He is saying of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “My refuge and my stronghold, My <dn>Elohim</dn>, in whom I trust!” [3] For <dn>He</dn> delivers you from the snare of a trapper, From the destructive pestilence. [4] <dn>He</dn> covers you with <dn>His</dn> feathers, And under <dn>His</dn> wings you take refuge; <dn>His</dn> truth is a shield and armour.

readings.title: The Mathematics of the Divine Hedge
readings.subtitle: Complete immunity to systemic disharmony and pestilence is guaranteed to those who remain in rank with the Creator.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:5] You are not afraid of the dread by night, Of the arrow that flies by day, [6] Of the pestilence that walks in darkness, Of destruction that ravages at midday. [7] A thousand fall at your side, And ten thousand at your right hand; But it does not come near you. [8] Only with your eyes you look on, And see the reward of the wrong ones.

readings.title: The Deployment of Angelic Logistics
readings.subtitle: Making YeHoVaH your absolute refuge triggers supernatural defense mechanisms, subjugating the terminal state of the serpent.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:9] Because you have made <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – My refuge, the Most High – your dwelling place, [10] No evil befalls you, And a plague does not come near your tent; [11] For <dn>He</dn> commands <dn>His</dn> messengers concerning you, To guard you in all your ways. [12] They bear you up in their hands, Lest you dash your foot against a stone. [13] You tread upon lion and cobra, Young lion and serpent you trample under foot.

readings.title: The Covenantal Guarantee of Deliverance
readings.subtitle: Knowing His true Name and cleaving to Him activates the highest level of premial justice and extended life.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:14] <dq>“Because he cleaves to <dn>Me</dn> in love, Therefore <dn>I</dn> deliver him; <dn>I</dn> set him on high, Because he has known <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Name.</dq> [15] <dq>“When he calls on <dn>Me</dn>, <dn>I</dn> answer him; <dn>I</dn> am with him in distress; <dn>I</dn> deliver him and esteem him.</dq> [16] <dq>“With long life <dn>I</dn> satisfy him, And show him <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> deliverance.”</dq>
